items.q: I know I'm a good musician... you come to town, Illinois Jacket come to town, Willis Jackson, Hal Sagle, everybody come to town and get a break

ctx.x: I mean a lot of those things he did (inaudible) he just sounds very corny.

You can't feel it in a lot of notes. I'm going to tell you -- I'm going to tell you a situation, something that -- I've got it on my lips, and I want to bring it up while we're talking about this, is technicians. Earl Bostick was a technician. Earl Bostick played a lot of notes. Earl Bostick, I told you, was responsible for my credit rating in New York through (inaudible). He vouched for me when my boss didn't vouch for me.

And when I had my spinal operation, he came up here and his wife came up to see me, and he said, come up for two reasons. I come up first to see you and see how you were doing, and then I want to ask you a question. He said, I know I'm a good musician. I know I know a lot of things to do. He said, but you come to town, Illinois Jacket come to town, Willis Jackson, Hal Sagle, everybody come to town and get a break, and I can't get a break, and I've been here, and I'm a good musician. What is wrong with me?
